findings.F01: Bounded complementary theme-park, explicit attraction, qualified farm/attraction/park description queries; positive seasonal evidence required. Exeter actual retained node is reachable without catalog insertion. No new operator/event scraping platform.
findings.F02: Generic/meditation/hedge mazes rejected; explicit corn/maize maze or structural maze plus corn/maize evidence accepted. Name evidence requires supported place context; negative/historical prose rejected.
findings.F03: Actual DateNightHome calls coherent decoration/eligibility model; OFF permits closed/upcoming/unconfirmed, excludes ended/not-operating/disused/permanent. ON requires positively open known hours and confirmed active season. Minute/focus/visibility refresh also refreshes overlays and Halloween activation.
findings.F04: Deterministic first-stage merge and stable representative ID/coordinates; category union and per-source activity/hours/lifecycle evidence retained. Conflicting live hours become unknown. Existing nearby dedupe distance rules unchanged. Plan selection preserves a distinct settle stop when available.
findings.F05: Explicit uncertainty/upcoming/ended/closure labels across options/result/plan. Existing Myer calendar/hours refreshed from retained same-day primary audit evidence, with sources and checked date. Both anchor calendars expire after 2026-10-31; next season requires revalidation.
findings.F06: Selected seasonal coverage derived per category from source evidence in browseable radius pool, before personal/Open-now filters. Distinguishes live contribution, saved-only, missing categories, sparse success and outage; eligible count unchanged in meaning.
